This is a neutral nonhuman adult female display mannequin, featureless smooth champagne resin skin, fully dressed in an opaque matte taupe scoop-neck broad-strap mid-thigh unitard, soft unpadded noncompressive fabric. Preserve the approved base body: moderately fuller relaxed waist, soft protruding lower abdomen and flanks, naturally low-positioned deflated chest silhouette with little upper fullness, gently flatter buttocks with restrained projection, substantial soft thighs. Do not slim, lift or augment this BASE.
OUTPUT: a single wide 3:2 image, precisely THREE equally sized vertical panels, seamless same warm ivory background, NO text, NO letters, NO border, NO separators. Preserve the heavier relaxed base rather than making an athletic idealized body.
